name: Okegawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Okegawa city emblem in maroon: a ring open at the bottom beneath a stylised crown of pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Okegawa, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1968.

features.role: Okegawa city emblem — a ring open at the bottom beneath a stylised crown of pointed strokes
